name: Kaynak/scene kimliği, bütünlük ve publish transaction

identityDeterminismMatrix.description: Same inputs produce identical sceneId and exactCacheKey across multiple calls
Different source SHA-256 produces unique sceneId
Different authoritative revision produces unique sceneId
Any change in compiler revision, schema version, or font digest forces new sceneId
Different tenant scope produces unique sceneId and cache key
Rejects empty string, whitespace, and ':latest' loose aliases

publishTransactionIntegrity.behavior: Intermediate writes take place in staging/<jobId> directory; target scene directory not exposed until full verification
Fencing token mismatch or job cancellation aborts transaction and purges staging directory
Staging directory files atomically committed to destination; memory maps registered strictly after disk write
Multi-byte UTF-8 Turkish layer names calculate exact byte length via Buffer.byteLength rather than character length
Cold process with empty RAM cache successfully reads manifest, binary chunks, index pages, and metadata pages from disk
